# Image fix-round fixtures
`image-fixed-writer.vrs` is generated by `cargo run --offline -j 3 -p varos-pdf --example freeze_image_fix` from the unchanged `varos-core/tests/fixtures/v6-images/embedded-crop.vrs`.
It pins the corrected main-writer appearance, Flate image streams and native associated-file envelope.
The original v6 image fixture remains frozen and is independently loaded by the regression test.
`passthrough.jpg` is an authored 4×4 RGB solid (240,10,30), Pillow JPEG quality 85; its exact original DCT bytes must reach the appearance XObject.
`cmyk-no-passthrough.jpg` is an authored 4×4 CMYK solid (0,240,220,0), Pillow JPEG quality 85; RGB interpretation must use decoded pixels and Flate, never a CMYK DCT mislabeled DeviceRGB.
